Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.keys

Class AesGcmTotpSecretCipher

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.keys.AesGcmTotpSecretCipher
All Implemented Interfaces:
TotpSecretCipher
@Component public class AesGcmTotpSecretCipher extends Object implements TotpSecretCipher
TotpSecretCipher that encrypts TOTP secrets with AES-256 in GCM mode. Its key is derived from the key-encryption passphrase with a salt of its own (PurposeKeyDerivation, purpose "totp-secret"), so it never shares the key that protects the signing keys. Each encryption uses a random initialisation vector, which is stored in front of the cipher text.
